description: This Java source file defines the OpenmrsClassScanner class, which provides reflection utilities for scanning classes in the classpath for specific annotations, interfaces, or other criteria within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for singleton management, classpath resource scanning, and filtering based on annotations.
